title: atropis paupercula
intro: Atropis paupercula, commonly known as Chinese angelica, is a plant species used in traditional Chinese medicine. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Atropis paupercula are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including coumarins, sesquiterpenoids, and phenolic acids, which exhibit anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and hepatoprotective activities.
